title: Website Change Monitor output
description: One dataset item per checked URL (after optional filter), plus SUMMARY and OUTPUT in the default key-value store. Snapshots live in the configured snapshot store.

results.title: Change-check results
results.description: Dataset items: url, httpStatus, contentHash, previousHash, changed, isFirstSeen, diffSummary, checkedAt, errorClass.

summary.title: SUMMARY report
summary.description: KV SUMMARY: totalChecked, changed, firstSeen, failed, charged, durationSecs, peakMemoryMb.

output.title: Run summary (OUTPUT)
output.description: KV OUTPUT: same as SUMMARY for sibling Actor consistency.
